questions.question: What evil does Ecclesiastes 6 describe?
options: A man to whom God gives wealth but not the power to enjoy it
A poor man who labors yet never escapes his poverty
A king who loses his throne to a wiser young rival
A wise man who saves a city, then is quickly forgotten
questions.answer: A man to whom God gives wealth but not the power to enjoy it

questions.question: What does Ecclesiastes 6 say about desire?
options: Desire fulfilled is a tree of life that satisfies the soul
The appetite is never satisfied, though all labor is for the mouth
A man's desire is his glory, and he should freely pursue it
The desire of the diligent is in the end richly supplied
questions.answer: The appetite is never satisfied, though all labor is for the mouth

questions.question: Ecclesiastes 6 observes that all the toil of man is for his mouth, yet his appetite is not satisfied.
All the toil of man is for his mouth, yet his _____ is not satisfied.
